assessment.rate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval on all terminal samples

cohort.v1_overlap_rule: new physical sample namespace and seed; no v1 shot is reused or pooled

sample_size_basis.qualification: Sensitivity calculation, not a guaranteed effect or power for the unknown min-sum contrast. The v1 effect is not pooled with v2 inference.

shared_work.cost_reporting: Report BP messages and calls, all additional typed intervention work, and measured controller runtime separately. A common message cap is not equal total work or parallel latency.

shared_work.runtime_method: time.perf_counter_ns:phase5-controller:v1 for intervention arms; ordinary canonical decode runtime for BP-only arms

studies.source_status: Independent controlled X-only BB72 CSS adaptation. The min-sum BP-SF arm remains different from the source's unseeded parallel first-arrival execution; no author-code reproduction or parallel-latency claim.

configuration.evaluation_rule: All evaluation profiles run on matched, independent physical samples. Four selected Beam-versus-Relay rate/damping contrasts use two-sided exact paired McNemar tests and Holm familywise correction at alpha=0.05; all other contrasts are descriptive. Every terminal shot counts; exact and stabilizer-equivalent outcomes are successes.
limitations: BB72 X-only CSS code capacity is a controlled adaptation of the cited circuit-level experiments.
The common plain-BP initial run is separate from Relay's paper-defined first memory-BP leg.
A shared additional C2V update cap does not equalize total operations, runtime, or parallel latency.
Selection and evaluation physical sample namespaces are disjoint; no outcome-dependent stopping is allowed.
configuration.selection_rule: For each rate, damping, and method independently: fewest unconditional failures on selection shots; then least total initial-plus-extra C2V work; then lexicographically first profile ID. Freeze before evaluation.

configuration.common_cost_rule: one sealed initial BP producer per physical sample; separate continuation and actual validation leaves
configuration.zero_candidate_original_check_rule: zero actual original checks when no candidate exists
